messages.content:
Pull out the details from this note as JSON with keys shop, item, price_rupees:

Bought a steel water bottle at Gupta Home Store today. It cost 349 rupees.
{"shop": "Gupta Home Store", "item": "steel water bottle", "price_rupees": 349}

Message from class teacher: "Parents, the annual day rehearsal is on Friday 14 November at 3 pm in the school hall. Children must wear white shirts."

Give me date, time, place and dress as JSON.
{"date": "Friday 14 November", "time": "3 pm", "place": "school hall", "dress": "white shirts"}
Ticket note: Train 12627 leaves Mysuru at 6:40 am and reaches Bengaluru at 9:15 am. Seat S4-32. Return it as JSON with keys train_number, from, to, departure, arrival, seat.
{"train_number": "12627", "from": "Mysuru", "to": "Bengaluru", "departure": "6:40 am", "arrival": "9:15 am", "seat": "S4-32"}

Extract as JSON (name, relation, birthday_month):
"My cousin Anjali's birthday is in March. She is my mother's sister's daughter."
{"name": "Anjali", "relation": "cousin", "birthday_month": "March"}
Here is a receipt: Sunrise Bakery. 2 butter buns at 15 rupees each, 1 loaf of bread 40 rupees. Total 70 rupees. Put it in JSON: shop, items (list of names), total.
{"shop": "Sunrise Bakery", "items": ["butter buns", "loaf of bread"], "total": 70}

Hey Rohan, I'm free on Sunday after lunch. Want to play cricket at the Nehru ground? Bring your bat. - Imran

JSON please: sender, recipient, day, activity, place.
{"sender": "Imran", "recipient": "Rohan", "day": "Sunday", "activity": "cricket", "place": "Nehru ground"}

From this notice, give json with keys meeting_day, start_time, room and agenda:

Team meeting moved to Tuesday, 11:30 am, Room B2. We will discuss the new rota.
{"meeting_day": "Tuesday", "start_time": "11:30 am", "room": "B2", "agenda": "new rota"}

Invitation: Join us for Diwali dinner at the Mehta house on 20 October. Dinner starts at 7:30 pm. Please bring a sweet dish. Reply by 15 October.
As JSON: occasion, host, date, time, bring, reply_by
{"occasion": "Diwali dinner", "host": "the Mehta family", "date": "20 October", "time": "7:30 pm", "bring": "a sweet dish", "reply_by": "15 October"}
Clinic reminder text: "Hello Mrs. Nair, your appointment with Dr. Kapoor is on 5 December at 10:00. Please come 10 minutes early." Output JSON with patient, doctor, date, time, arrive_early_minutes.
{"patient": "Mrs. Nair", "doctor": "Dr. Kapoor", "date": "5 December", "time": "10:00", "arrive_early_minutes": 10}
Match note: Blue Hawks beat Green Tigers 3-1 in the final. Star scorer was Meera with two goals. Give JSON keys winner, loser, winner_goals, loser_goals, top_scorer.
{"winner": "Blue Hawks", "loser": "Green Tigers", "winner_goals": 3, "loser_goals": 1, "top_scorer": "Meera"}
Put this in JSON with keys amount, reason, deadline: "Please send 1,200 rupees for the school trip by Monday."
{"amount": 1200, "reason": "school trip", "deadline": "Monday"}

Notice at the school gate: Because of heavy rain forecast for Thursday, the picnic is postponed. New date will be announced later.
Return JSON with event, status, reason, new_date.
{"event": "picnic", "status": "postponed", "reason": "heavy rain forecast for Thursday", "new_date": null}
Bill from Kavita Stationery: 3 notebooks (25 rupees each), 1 geometry box (90 rupees). Paid by cash. Make JSON with keys shop, notebooks_count, notebook_price, geometry_box_price, payment_method.
{"shop": "Kavita Stationery", "notebooks_count": 3, "notebook_price": 25, "geometry_box_price": 90, "payment_method": "cash"}
Landlord message: The water supply will be off on Saturday from 9 am to 1 pm because of tank cleaning. Extract JSON: day, from_time, to_time, reason.
{"day": "Saturday", "from_time": "9 am", "to_time": "1 pm", "reason": "tank cleaning"}
Library slip: Book "The Jungle Friends" borrowed by Tara on 3 September, due back 17 September. JSON with title, borrower, borrowed_on, due_on please.
{"title": "The Jungle Friends", "borrower": "Tara", "borrowed_on": "3 September", "due_on": "17 September"}
Field note: Saw two peacocks and one monkey near the old well at 6 am. Nobody else was around. Can you give a JSON with animals (a list), place, time?
{"animals": ["peacocks", "monkey"], "place": "near the old well", "time": "6 am"}
Hotel booking: Guest Daniel Brooks, 2 nights from 12 June, Room 204, breakfast included. JSON with guest, nights, check_in, room, breakfast_included.
{"guest": "Daniel Brooks", "nights": 2, "check_in": "12 June", "room": "204", "breakfast_included": true}
Text from Sana: "I got 18 out of 20 in the science quiz and 15 in maths." JSON keys: science_score, science_total, maths_score
{"science_score": 18, "science_total": 20, "maths_score": 15}
Job ad: Wanted, a part-time shop helper at Lotus Sweets, Pune. Hours 4 pm to 8 pm. Pay 400 rupees a day. Make JSON: job, shop, city, hours, daily_pay, phone.
{"job": "part-time shop helper", "shop": "Lotus Sweets", "city": "Pune", "hours": "4 pm to 8 pm", "daily_pay": 400, "phone": null}
Recipe note: Masala omelette needs 2 eggs, 1 chopped onion, 1 green chilli and a pinch of salt. Cooking time is about 5 minutes. Give me JSON with dish, ingredients as an array, minutes.
{"dish": "Masala omelette", "ingredients": ["2 eggs", "1 chopped onion", "1 green chilli", "a pinch of salt"], "minutes": 5}
I'm going to be late. I'll reach the cafe near the bus stand at 5:45 instead of 5. - Neha. Put in JSON the sender, new_arrival_time, original_time and place.
{"sender": "Neha", "new_arrival_time": "5:45", "original_time": "5", "place": "cafe near the bus stand"}
Poster text: Holi Mela at Green Park, Sunday 9 March, 10 am to 4 pm. Free entry. Colours and snacks on sale. Give JSON event, venue, date, open, close, entry_fee.
{"event": "Holi Mela", "venue": "Green Park", "date": "Sunday 9 March", "open": "10 am", "close": "4 pm", "entry_fee": "free"}
Coach note: Swimming practice for juniors every Monday and Thursday at 6 am, at the Lakeview pool. Fees 800 rupees per month. JSON, keys: sport, group, days (array), time, place, monthly_fee.
{"sport": "swimming", "group": "juniors", "days": ["Monday", "Thursday"], "time": "6 am", "place": "Lakeview pool", "monthly_fee": 800}
Pocket money log: Got 200 rupees from Dadi, spent 60 on a pencil box and 40 on samosas. In JSON, give received, spent_on_pencil_box, spent_on_samosas, left.
{"received": 200, "spent_on_pencil_box": 60, "spent_on_samosas": 40, "left": 100}
Radio note: Tomorrow will be sunny in Jaipur with a high of 34 degrees and a low of 21. Light wind from the west. JSON with city, sky, high_c, low_c, wind.
{"city": "Jaipur", "sky": "sunny", "high_c": 34, "low_c": 21, "wind": "light, from the west"}
New neighbour introduced herself: she is Mrs. Fernandes from flat 3C and has a small dog called Bruno. Extract name, flat, pet_name, pet_type as JSON.
{"name": "Mrs. Fernandes", "flat": "3C", "pet_name": "Bruno", "pet_type": "dog"}
Review: I read "Moon Garden" in two days. Lovely pictures, but the ending felt rushed. 4 stars. JSON keys title, days_to_read, stars, complaint.
{"title": "Moon Garden", "days_to_read": 2, "stars": 4, "complaint": "the ending felt rushed"}
Principal's circular: School reopens on 2 June. Uniform is compulsory. Bus timings stay the same. Output as JSON: reopening_date, uniform_compulsory, bus_timings_changed.
{"reopening_date": "2 June", "uniform_compulsory": true, "bus_timings_changed": false}
Auto driver told me the fare to the airport is about 450 rupees and it takes around 40 minutes without traffic. Put it in JSON: destination, fare_rupees, minutes.
{"destination": "airport", "fare_rupees": 450, "minutes": 40}
Dad's message: Grandpa's train arrives Saturday evening. Someone must pick him up from the station. I'll go. Which day, who picks up, and where? JSON keys day, who_picks_up, pickup_place.
{"day": "Saturday evening", "who_picks_up": "Dad", "pickup_place": "station"}
Menu board at Raju's Tea Stall: Tea 10 rupees, Coffee 15 rupees, Bun maska 25 rupees. As JSON give stall and a menu object with each item and its price.
{"stall": "Raju's Tea Stall", "menu": {"Tea": 10, "Coffee": 15, "Bun maska": 25}}
Reminder: your delivery to Mr. Verma is booked for 3 pm tomorrow at 14 Lake Road. Parcel is fragile. Extract json recipient, time, address, fragile.
{"recipient": "Mr. Verma", "time": "3 pm tomorrow", "address": "14 Lake Road", "fragile": true}
Gym notice: The yoga class now starts at 6:30 am instead of 7 am. Teacher is Ms. Rao. Give JSON class, new_start, old_start, teacher.
{"class": "yoga", "new_start": "6:30 am", "old_start": "7 am", "teacher": "Ms. Rao"}
Shopkeeper's note: Rice is 62 rupees a kilo, dal 120 rupees a kilo. Today I sold 5 kilos of rice. JSON: rice_price_per_kg, dal_price_per_kg, rice_sold_kg.
{"rice_price_per_kg": 62, "dal_price_per_kg": 120, "rice_sold_kg": 5}
Eid greeting from Zoya: Eid Mubarak, Ali! Come to our house on Monday for sewaiyan. We eat at 1 pm. Give recipient, sender, day, food, meal_time in JSON.
{"recipient": "Ali", "sender": "Zoya", "day": "Monday", "food": "sewaiyan", "meal_time": "1 pm"}
Garden diary: Planted 4 tomato plants and 2 chilli plants on Sunday. Watered them with a mug each. JSON keys: day, tomato_plants, chilli_plants.
{"day": "Sunday", "tomato_plants": 4, "chilli_plants": 2}

Message: Kabir's birthday party is at my place, 6 pm Saturday. Don't tell him, it's a surprise! - Leena

JSON: guest_of_honour, host, day, time, is_surprise
{"guest_of_honour": "Kabir", "host": "Leena", "day": "Saturday", "time": "6 pm", "is_surprise": true}
Homework diary: English essay due Wednesday, maths worksheet due Thursday, no science homework. JSON with english, maths, science. Use null for none.
{"english": "essay due Wednesday", "maths": "worksheet due Thursday", "science": null}
Electricity slip: Meter reading 4520, previous 4380. Bill amount 840 rupees. Due date 22nd. Output JSON: current_reading, previous_reading, amount_rupees, due_day.
{"current_reading": 4520, "previous_reading": 4380, "amount_rupees": 840, "due_day": "22nd"}
Race result: Arjun 1st, Mei 2nd, Tomas 3rd in the 100 metre race. Winning time was 14 seconds. Return JSON with first, second, third, winning_time_seconds.
{"first": "Arjun", "second": "Mei", "third": "Tomas", "winning_time_seconds": 14}
Bus ticket: Route 45 from Dadar to Andheri, fare 18 rupees, 1 adult and 1 child. JSON: route, from, to, fare, adults, children.
{"route": "45", "from": "Dadar", "to": "Andheri", "fare": 18, "adults": 1, "children": 1}
Email: Hi team, I will be on leave from 3 to 7 March. Please contact Priya for urgent things. Regards, Sameer. Extract sender, leave_start, leave_end, backup_contact as JSON.
{"sender": "Sameer", "leave_start": "3 March", "leave_end": "7 March", "backup_contact": "Priya"}
Moving note: The sofa goes to the living room, the bed to the small room, and the boxes to the kitchen. In JSON map each item to its room.
{"sofa": "living room", "bed": "small room", "boxes": "kitchen"}
Reading club: We meet on the last Friday of every month at 5 pm in the school library. This month we read a poem. JSON, please: frequency, day, time, place, this_month_reading.
{"frequency": "monthly", "day": "last Friday", "time": "5 pm", "place": "school library", "this_month_reading": "a poem"}
Wedding card: Feast for 300 guests, served on banana leaves. Menu has dosa, sambar, payasam. JSON keys guests, served_on, dishes, cost.
{"guests": 300, "served_on": "banana leaves", "dishes": ["dosa", "sambar", "payasam"], "cost": null}
School nurse note: Ravi has a sore throat and went home at 11 am. His mother Mrs. Sharma was called. Give JSON student, symptom, left_at, parent_called.
{"student": "Ravi", "symptom": "sore throat", "left_at": "11 am", "parent_called": "Mrs. Sharma"}
Trip diary: It rained for 3 days in Kochi, then stopped on the fourth day. We stayed at a houseboat. JSON keys city, rainy_days, lodging.
{"city": "Kochi", "rainy_days": 3, "lodging": "houseboat"}
Receipt from Fresh Basket Grocers, Leeds: milk 1.20, eggs 2.50, tea bags 1.80. Total 5.50 pounds. Can you write the shop, city, total and currency as JSON?
{"shop": "Fresh Basket Grocers", "city": "Leeds", "total": 5.5, "currency": "pounds"}

Teacher Ms. Dsouza wrote: Sports day is on 8 February. Parents are welcome. Please send the signed slip back. She did not say what time it starts. JSON: organiser, event, date, start_time, parents_welcome.
{"organiser": "Ms. Dsouza", "event": "Sports day", "date": "8 February", "start_time": null, "parents_welcome": true}
Flight note: Flight AB204 from Delhi to Dubai departs 02:15, gate 12. Boarding closes 35 minutes before. I need a JSON with flight, origin, destination, departs, gate, boarding_closes_before_minutes.
{"flight": "AB204", "origin": "Delhi", "destination": "Dubai", "departs": "02:15", "gate": "12", "boarding_closes_before_minutes": 35}
My uncle Vikram lives in Nagpur and works as a bus driver. He has two daughters, Isha and Riya. Make JSON with name, city, job, daughters (a list).
{"name": "Vikram", "city": "Nagpur", "job": "bus driver", "daughters": ["Isha", "Riya"]}
Order slip, table 7: 2 plain dosas, 1 filter coffee, 1 vada. The customer asked for no onions. Output JSON with table, items and special_request. Items should be an array.
{"table": 7, "items": ["2 plain dosas", "1 filter coffee", "1 vada"], "special_request": "no onions"}
Ping from Maya: sorry I can't come to the movie on Friday, my cousin is visiting. Maybe next week? Give JSON: sender, can_attend, reason, suggestion.
{"sender": "Maya", "can_attend": false, "reason": "her cousin is visiting", "suggestion": "next week"}
Shift roster line: Arun works Mon-Wed 9 to 5. Sara works Thu-Sat 10 to 6. Sunday closed. JSON object with arun and sara, each having days and hours.
{"arun": {"days": "Mon-Wed", "hours": "9 to 5"}, "sara": {"days": "Thu-Sat", "hours": "10 to 6"}}

Ganesh Chaturthi plan: the idol arrives on Tuesday morning, aarti every evening at 7, visarjan on the 5th day. Neighbourhood committee head is Mr. Joshi. As JSON, keys committee_head, idol_arrival, aarti_time, visarjan_day.
{"committee_head": "Mr. Joshi", "idol_arrival": "Tuesday morning", "aarti_time": "7 in the evening", "visarjan_day": "5th day"}
Pharmacy label reads: Patient Meena Roy, collected on 11 July, pickup by her son. Extract JSON with patient, date_collected, collected_by.
{"patient": "Meena Roy", "date_collected": "11 July", "collected_by": "her son"}
Cricket scorecard: Sunil made 54 runs off 40 balls. Pooja took 3 wickets. Their team, the Lions, won by 12 runs. Put in JSON: team, batter, runs, balls, bowler, wickets, margin_runs.
{"team": "Lions", "batter": "Sunil", "runs": 54, "balls": 40, "bowler": "Pooja", "wickets": 3, "margin_runs": 12}
Note from mum: Dhruv, I left 500 rupees in the blue drawer for the milkman. He comes on the 1st. As JSON: addressee, amount, location, purpose, visit_day.
{"addressee": "Dhruv", "amount": 500, "location": "blue drawer", "purpose": "to pay the milkman", "visit_day": "1st"}
Forecast: Showers likely in Chennai tomorrow, humidity high, temperature around 31. JSON: city, rain_likely, temperature_c, wind_speed.
{"city": "Chennai", "rain_likely": true, "temperature_c": 31, "wind_speed": null}
Plumber's card: Ramesh Plumbing, mobile 98450 12345, open 8 am to 8 pm, Sunday off. JSON name, phone, opens, closes, closed_day.
{"name": "Ramesh Plumbing", "phone": "98450 12345", "opens": "8 am", "closes": "8 pm", "closed_day": "Sunday"}
I borrowed three books: a mystery, a cookbook and a poetry book. I finished only the mystery. In JSON list borrowed (array) and finished.
{"borrowed": ["mystery", "cookbook", "poetry book"], "finished": "mystery"}
Report card line: Name Farhan Ali, Class 6B, Roll no 17, attendance 92 percent. Give JSON with keys name, class, roll_no, attendance_percent.
{"name": "Farhan Ali", "class": "6B", "roll_no": 17, "attendance_percent": 92}

Hostel booking confirmation for Chloe Martin, Lisbon, 3 nights, arrival 9 August, bed in a 6-bed dorm, price 66 euros total. Extract to JSON: guest, city, nights, arrival, room_type, total_price, currency.
{"guest": "Chloe Martin", "city": "Lisbon", "nights": 3, "arrival": "9 August", "room_type": "6-bed dorm", "total_price": 66, "currency": "euros"}

Rani's chai recipe: 1 cup water, 1 cup milk, 2 spoons tea leaves, 2 spoons sugar, 1 small piece of ginger. Boil for 3 minutes. Please return JSON with water_cups, milk_cups, tea_spoons, sugar_spoons, boil_minutes.
{"water_cups": 1, "milk_cups": 1, "tea_spoons": 2, "sugar_spoons": 2, "boil_minutes": 3}
From Tom: Mate, I've moved to Cardiff for a new job at a bookshop. Come and visit in spring! Output JSON with keys person, new_city, workplace, invite_season.
{"person": "Tom", "new_city": "Cardiff", "workplace": "bookshop", "invite_season": "spring"}
Offer letter: Dear Kiran, you are invited to join Blue Peak Textiles as an accounts clerk starting 1 April. JSON with candidate, company, role, start_date, salary.
{"candidate": "Kiran", "company": "Blue Peak Textiles", "role": "accounts clerk", "start_date": "1 April", "salary": null}
Pongal wish: Wishing you a happy Pongal! We will cook sweet pongal on the terrace on Wednesday at 8 am. Aunt Lakshmi is making it. JSON: festival, dish, place, day, time, cook.
{"festival": "Pongal", "dish": "sweet pongal", "place": "terrace", "day": "Wednesday", "time": "8 am", "cook": "Aunt Lakshmi"}
Walk log: Walked 4 kilometres in 50 minutes this morning around Cubbon Park. Can you turn this into JSON with keys distance_km, duration_minutes, place, time_of_day?
{"distance_km": 4, "duration_minutes": 50, "place": "Cubbon Park", "time_of_day": "morning"}
Chess club: Tournament on 21 September, 20 players, entry fee 100 rupees, prize is a trophy. Venue not decided. JSON keys date, players, entry_fee, prize, venue.
{"date": "21 September", "players": 20, "entry_fee": 100, "prize": "trophy", "venue": null}
Savings jar notes: Week one 50 rupees, week two 30 rupees, week three 70 rupees. Give JSON with a weeks array of the amounts and a total.
Trekker's log: At the summit it was minus 4 degrees, foggy, and windy. Reached the top at 11:20. Record in JSON: temperature_c, visibility, wind, reached_at.
{"temperature_c": -4, "visibility": "foggy", "wind": "windy", "reached_at": "11:20"}
Flatmate rules: Rent 9000 each, due on the 5th. Cleaning rota changes weekly. Guests allowed until 10 pm. Return JSON rent_each, rent_due_day, guest_cutoff.
{"rent_each": 9000, "rent_due_day": "5th", "guest_cutoff": "10 pm"}
Book blurb: "Seven Rivers" is a novel by Anita Sen about a girl who walks from the mountains to the sea. 280 pages. JSON title, author, pages, genre.
{"title": "Seven Rivers", "author": "Anita Sen", "pages": 280, "genre": "novel"}
Noticeboard: Science fair registration closes on 25 August. Teams of 2 or 3 students. Topic must be about water. JSON for me: event, deadline, team_size_min, team_size_max, topic.
{"event": "Science fair", "deadline": "25 August", "team_size_min": 2, "team_size_max": 3, "topic": "water"}
Cab confirmation: Driver Mohan, white sedan, number KA 05 MB 1234, pickup at 7:10 pm from Indiranagar. Fill JSON: driver, car_colour, car_type, plate, pickup_time, pickup_area.
{"driver": "Mohan", "car_colour": "white", "car_type": "sedan", "plate": "KA 05 MB 1234", "pickup_time": "7:10 pm", "pickup_area": "Indiranagar"}
Grandma's story: When she was 8, she lived in a village near Madurai with her 3 brothers. Give me JSON: age_then, village_region, brothers.
{"age_then": 8, "village_region": "near Madurai", "brothers": 3}
Sticker on a jar: Mango pickle, made by Sharma Aunty, packed 15 May, best before 15 November. Weight 500 g. I need it as JSON: product, maker, packed_on, best_before, weight_g.
{"product": "Mango pickle", "maker": "Sharma Aunty", "packed_on": "15 May", "best_before": "15 November", "weight_g": 500}
Lina texted: Can you lend me your history notes till Thursday? I'll return them with chocolate. JSON keys requester, item, until, offer.
{"requester": "Lina", "item": "history notes", "until": "Thursday", "offer": "chocolate"}
Delivery boy's note: 12 parcels today, 2 returned because nobody was home. Worked from 9 am to 6 pm. JSON delivered, returned, shift_start, shift_end. Delivered is the count that got delivered.
{"delivered": 10, "returned": 2, "shift_start": "9 am", "shift_end": "6 pm"}
Christmas fair flyer: Cake stalls, carol singing at 5 pm, Santa visit at 6 pm, St. Mary's School ground, 20 December. Make JSON: event, venue, date, carols_time, santa_time.
{"event": "Christmas fair", "venue": "St. Mary's School ground", "date": "20 December", "carols_time": "5 pm", "santa_time": "6 pm"}
Sleep diary: Went to bed at 10:30 pm, woke at 6 am, woke once in the night. JSON bedtime, wake_time, night_wakings.
{"bedtime": "10:30 pm", "wake_time": "6 am", "night_wakings": 1}
Kabaddi team sheet: Captain Gopal, vice-captain Yash, 7 players on court, coach Mr. Das. Respond with JSON: captain, vice_captain, players_on_court, coach.
{"captain": "Gopal", "vice_captain": "Yash", "players_on_court": 7, "coach": "Mr. Das"}

Fee notice: Term two fee is 4500 rupees. Pay online or at the office. Late fee 50 rupees per day after 10 January. Please give me JSON using the keys term, fee, payment_options (array), late_fee_per_day, last_date.
{"term": "two", "fee": 4500, "payment_options": ["online", "at the office"], "late_fee_per_day": 50, "last_date": "10 January"}
Farmer's note: No rain for 12 days in the village, wells are low, but the wind is cool in the evening. In JSON: dry_days, wells, evening_wind.
{"dry_days": 12, "wells": "low", "evening_wind": "cool"}
Parcel slip: Delivered to the security guard at Block C on Tuesday at 4:05 pm. Signed by guard. JSON with delivered_to, place, day, time.
{"delivered_to": "security guard", "place": "Block C", "day": "Tuesday", "time": "4:05 pm"}
Teacher's list: Read chapters 3 and 4 of "The Brave Calf" for Monday. Write 5 lines about the calf. Output JSON with book, chapters (array of numbers), due_day, lines_to_write.
{"book": "The Brave Calf", "chapters": [3, 4], "due_day": "Monday", "lines_to_write": 5}
Bird count: 6 sparrows, 3 crows, 1 kingfisher. Counted at the pond by Tara. As JSON: counter, place, counts (an object by bird).
{"counter": "Tara", "place": "pond", "counts": {"sparrows": 6, "crows": 3, "kingfisher": 1}}
Teacher: Anil missed the test on Tuesday because he was sick. He will write it on Monday. Marks not yet available. JSON student, missed_on, reason, makeup_day, marks.
{"student": "Anil", "missed_on": "Tuesday", "reason": "sick", "makeup_day": "Monday", "marks": null}
Trip plan: leave Pune on Friday at 5 am by car, reach Goa by 2 pm, stay 3 nights at a beach hut. Return JSON origin, destination, leave_day, leave_time, arrive_time, nights, stay.
{"origin": "Pune", "destination": "Goa", "leave_day": "Friday", "leave_time": "5 am", "arrive_time": "2 pm", "nights": 3, "stay": "beach hut"}
Repair shop slip: Mr. Khan's watch left for a new strap on 6 October. Ready in 3 days. Charge 250 rupees. Make a JSON object with customer, item, service, left_on, ready_in_days, charge_rupees.
{"customer": "Mr. Khan", "item": "watch", "service": "new strap", "left_on": "6 October", "ready_in_days": 3, "charge_rupees": 250}
Voice note summary: Zara says her new puppy is named Biscuit, is brown, and is 8 weeks old. Give me JSON: owner, puppy_name, colour, age_weeks.
{"owner": "Zara", "puppy_name": "Biscuit", "colour": "brown", "age_weeks": 8}
Whiteboard: Deadline for the poster is Thursday noon. Designer Asha, printer Mr. Bose. Budget 3000 rupees. JSON keys deadline, designer, printer, budget.
{"deadline": "Thursday noon", "designer": "Asha", "printer": "Mr. Bose", "budget": 3000}
Fruit stall board: Bananas 40 per dozen, apples 150 per kilo, papaya out of stock today. JSON: bananas_per_dozen, apples_per_kg, papaya.  Use null for papaya.
{"bananas_per_dozen": 40, "apples_per_kg": 150, "papaya": null}

Circular: Students of class 9 will visit the science museum on 12 December. Bus leaves at 8 am. Carry lunch and a water bottle. Fee 150 rupees. Convert to JSON: class, destination, date, bus_time, carry (array), fee.
{"class": 9, "destination": "science museum", "date": "12 December", "bus_time": "8 am", "carry": ["lunch", "water bottle"], "fee": 150}
Sale tag at Blossom Boutique: Cotton kurta, was 900 rupees, now 650 rupees, sizes M and L. JSON shop, item, old_price, new_price, sizes.
{"shop": "Blossom Boutique", "item": "cotton kurta", "old_price": 900, "new_price": 650, "sizes": ["M", "L"]}
